title: Xenium in situ tissue cohort clinical pathology ground truth and confounder discrimination study
claim_target: Spatial domain segmentation achieves mean morphological Dice coefficient >= 0.75 against clinical pathologist ground truth masks and passes artifact discrimination battery.
claim_exclusions: sub-cellular organelle inference below physical diffraction limits
clinical diagnostic staging without certified surgical pathology board sign-off

locked_endpoints.pathology_concordance: mean domain Dice coefficient must be >= 0.75
locked_endpoints.artifact_discrimination: must pass 4/4 tests distinguishing genuine interface biology from optical blur, cell density, and FOV seams
